Apple smb-217.19, commit 1b47f5645571a9af0e85e55af5ff68f09d310537
https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/smb/tree/smb-217.19

Original source and file notices copied directly, without a Git submodule.
The original project embeds smbfs1.3.7 metadata, matching the native Tiger
8R4088 bundle version. A matching version is not itself runtime ABI proof.

Purpose: narrow native Tiger Finder SMB client compatibility backport,
preserving Darwin8 VFS, ioctl, Kerberos and filesystem semantics. Do not
replace it wholesale with a later filesystem driver or weaken host SMB policy.
Current changes: prefer direct-hosted TCP445 before the original TCP139
transport; omit the NetBIOS session handshake on direct-hosted transport;
advertise Unicode in the unsigned dialect-negotiation header without changing
the mandatory ASCII dialect list or later VC encoding. No credential/signature
checks are bypassed.

Status: bounded transport research, not part of the app's default payload
and not a qualified native Finder mount. The original
source compiles all29 kernel source-phase units against the genuine10.4u SDK
and xnu-792.22.5 private headers. The period compiler survey is reproducible
using Source/probes/build-leopard-smb-client.py with an explicit10.4u SDK.
The changed native i386 relocatable links with all226 imports provided by
the actual8R4088 kernel. The native guest loader validates/loads it from a
temporary root-owned directory without replacing a system file. The native
smbutil failure changes from Connection refused to Function not implemented,
consistent with reaching the still-unimplemented extended-authentication path.
After the finite test it is unloaded and the original system kext reloaded.
Do not call this evidence of a signed/authenticated mount or complete fix.

October31 native client checkpoint (research337, not yet packaged):
The new BSD-2-Clause vim_ntlmssp_wire/native files add cold NTLMv2/SPNEGO
authentication inside the original password-ioctl/IOD path. Existing Finder,
mount_smbfs, smbutil, public ioctl and VFS interfaces are unchanged. No new
password store, authentication proxy, global host policy or runtime injection.
The source phase now has31 units, linked for the genuine Darwin8 i386 ABI.

Apple Heimdal-710.0.1 accept_sec_context/crypto and the live host's digest
metadata explain the key-exchange requirement: a valid NTLMv2 password proof
alone was insufficient; the SPNEGO MIC also needed the negotiated128-bit
key-exchange path. The implementation includes transcript MIC, directional
mech-list MIC and random exported session key, without LM/NTLMv1 fallback.
The host accepts the correct negotiation and rejects a deliberately corrupted
mech-list MIC. MS-NLMP synthetic vectors plus independent CommonCrypto RC4/MIC
checks pass under address/undefined-behavior sanitizers.

Native Darwin10 smb_rq_sign/verify are the reference for session-setup's
BSRSPLY placeholder and ordinary signed-request sequence2/reply3. Only the
bounded authentication phase permits an unsigned SMB setup response; GSS
completion/guest rejection and any supplied server mech MIC are still checked.
Every following signed operation verifies the actual server packet MAC.

Two small native interoperability adaptations accompany authentication:
- Darwin9 smbfs_smb_statfs: use SMB_QFS_SIZE_INFO's24-byte64-bit response
  when NT SMBs are negotiated. The old18-byte allocation query demonstrably
  fails with STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH on the modern Apple server.
- Darwin10 smb_t2_request_int: retain negotiated Unicode and encode the named
  TRANSACTION name accordingly. The original OEM flag yields signed
  STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED replies to the native RPC pipe request. Correct Unicode
  transactions let stock Tiger smbutil list all11 modern-host shares.

The research driver is loaded only from a temporary root-owned guest bundle;
the Apple system kext remains unchanged. Native mount, stat/list, read/write,
normal cp, and Unicode-filename round-trip pass through the running production
app's normal network, without a custom SMB service. This is component evidence,
not proof of a finished Finder UI flow, fresh-install packaging, minor-update
recovery, other Tiger builds, or Leopard compatibility. Those gates stay open.
The optional --trace builder flag emits failed-transaction numeric metadata
only; ordinary builds omit it. No tokens, keys, paths or credentials are logged.

Research342 preserves Tiger Finder's anonymous-probe/password-retry contract:
an unsupported empty-account probe returns EAUTH before the IOD can close the
still-unauthed negotiated transport. The ordinary named-account path retains
full NTLMv2/SPNEGO and packet-MAC verification. Visible native Finder browsing,
direct mount and a Unicode-named103-byte Finder-copy round trip pass. An
intermittent post-share-selection disconnect remains under investigation;
the full outgoing-sharing qualification gate is still open.

The component is now packaged with Tiger's native controls. The production
file-sharing helper publishes/loads a private copy from GuestTools, leaving
Apple's original system smbfs.kext and all active mounts untouched. An already
loaded different client requires the ordinary setup restart; the existing
one-shot cold job then loads the private native client. No kernel-cache or
host-security changes are used. First cold-load and repeat-repair checks pass;
this does not qualify every Finder operation, minor update, or ARM host.

Client policy2 exposes a read-only net.smb.fs.vim_client=2 resident-identity
OID through Darwin8's original registration seam. The cold loader uses it to
distinguish the actual backported implementation from the stock same-version
bundle: measured native kextload returns success for "already loaded" without
proving which implementation was loaded. No writable policy, resident poller,
filesystem ABI or host-security change is added. Normal app policy upgrade,
automatic restart and the resident2 marker pass in the real production guest.
